messages:
Alex H: quick mock: compact billing list with token chips, small sparklines, and 2 CTAs: Export CSV + Invoice. thoughts? https://figma.link/compact-billing

Maria L: looks tidy. accessibility nit: token chip contrast too low. also prefer 'Export CSV' as primary and hide Invoice behind billing perms.

Ben T: agree on CSV primary. perf: need row virtualization for orgs with many projects. sparklines should lazy-load.

Sam - Eng: API note: send last_period_delta and billed_tokens (post-cache) so UI labels can be explicit. avoid client-side token math.

Kim (prod): default scope should be org for billing admins. for project viewers show a subtle banner 'Viewing project spend' so they don't try to download invoices.

Maria L: proposed copy: 'Estimated billed tokens (after caching)' + info tooltip. Color suggestion for chip: #4A47D8 for AA contrast.

Alex H: action items: Maria update mock + copy, Ben add feature flag & virtualization spike, Sam add delta to API, Kim schedule preview. I'll book a short review slot next Wed.
